rows.detail_main_html:
Dreadful Countenance II

Dread Knight · Level 4 · Wave of Despair

Effect

Your opponent's fear of you mounts, as does the debilitation caused by it. Incoming Critical: +7%, All Resistances: Reduced, Incoming Spiritual Damage: +5%

Notes

Level: 5 Spell/Skill

Seething Hatred, read from this same client, says it “Increases your Dreadful Countenance”. So the build carries this ability even though the spellbook does not list it, which is what the passive reasoning above predicted.

Probably not a separate rank. The client shows a single unranked Dreadful Countenance at level 1 whose debuff builds “up to 5 stages”, and this row's wording -- the opponent's fear mounting, with the debilitation it causes -- reads like a description of one of those stages rather than a second ability. It is kept because only two abilities from the General tab have been seen so far, which is not enough to say what else is on it.
